mustPreserve: recognizable main circulation and supply/return roles
separate food, airway and urine passages
clear playable access and sufficient cell clearance
maySimplify: intermediate small branch count and winding
individual finger and toe vascular detail
overlapping logical gates into one readable exchange area
generationGuide.defaultOrganPattern: one readable supply, one readable return, a small number of exchange areas; retain essential special cases such as hepatic portal supply and pulmonary circulation
visualRules: Use smooth broad curves and clear branch junctions.
Avoid bundles of closely parallel vessels, dense tiny branches, overlapping door symbols and long decorative detours.
Preserve quiet tissue space for unit selection and combat.
Generate regional assets with stable main anchors, then recheck geometry and gameplay after any simplification.
prioritySimplificationSites: stomach portal-bank and outer-wall service connections
left-lung exchange approach and holding space
hand and foot distal branch density
generationGuide.acceptance: The existing 202 edges and 29 logical gates are verification data, not a requirement to draw all of them. A simplified guide must be checked for legibility, movement and generation feasibility before final assets.

rules: Use GPT image generation for final raster assets, retaining the reference illustration style and low visual noise suitable for RTS cells.

The validated graph records centerlines, widths, branch IDs, endpoints, layers and logical gates for comparison. Simplify the proposed visual graph first; preserve major anchors and gameplay clearance, not every tested bend or small branch.
Recorded green tissue movement trajectories are QA evidence, not additional blood vessels. Do not convert those trajectories into vascular artwork.
Food, airway and urinary passages remain separate from vessels. Pulmonary blue bronchi must not be treated as veins.
Use shared 1024x1536 coordinates and recorded crop offsets; independently generated crops must not be repositioned by visual fitting.

Post-generation overlap inspection and the same collision/clearance tests are required before accepting image layers. Changes to route geometry must update the shared guide and rerun movement checks; generated pixels alone never define collision.
Fine organ walls, joints, foreground occlusion masks and the 0.15 zoom handoff still require their own art acceptance.
